 Cotton’s History
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Cotton’s Restaurant is located on Pleasure Island in Orange Beach, Alabama. We have been serving families, friends and guests since 1985. Featuring lobster, oysters, steaks, and the best seafood the area has to offer. Our fresh fish is a standard menu item. We are honored to have been voted the Best Steak in South Baldwin County by the “People’s Choice Award”

 Starters
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 POTATO SKINS
Fried Potato Jackets topped with melted Cheddar Cheese, Chives & Bacon Bits. Sour Cream served on the side. 10.95
 
 
 
 
 
 **TUNA NACHOS
House made fried Won Tons with seared Ahi Tuna, Seaweed Salad & topped with Spicy Mayo & Eel Sauce. MP
 
 
 
 
 
 GULF SHRIMP STEAMED
8-10 per order. Served hot or cold. 10.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 COTTON’S CRAB QUESO
Melted Pepper Jack Cheese infused with Onions& Crab Meat. Served with toasted  Pita Points. 12.95
 
 
 
 
 
 COTTON’S CRAB CAKES
Deep fried or blackened, topped with lump Crabmeat & our Remoulade Sauce. 14.95
 
 
 
 
 
 COVE SPICY SHRIMP
Fried Bay Shrimp tossed in a mild Chili Sauce. 12.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
Fresh local grown Tomatoes breaded & fried. Topped with our house made Tomato Relish, Feta Cheese & Remoulade Sauce. 12.95
 
 
 
 
 
 CRAB CLAWS
Fresh from the Gulf of Mexico. Fried or Sautéed. MP
 
 
 
 
 
 ‘SHROOMS
Local favorite for over 35 years.Fresh Mushroom Caps filled with our signature Herb Cheese & deep fried to perfection. 12.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Salads & Such
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 COVE BURGER
Hand pattied Angus Ground Beef, seasoned & cooked over flame roasted chargrill, toasted Bun with Lettuce, Tomato, sliced Onion & hamburger Dill Pickles. Cooked to order. One side. 14.95
 
 
 
 
 
 HOUSE SALAD
Fresh tossed Greens with seasonalVegetables, Cheddar Cheese, Bacon Bits & your choice of dressing. 6.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 STUFFED AVOCADO
Avocado Seasoned and Chargrilled. Stuffed with Blackened Chicken or Shrimp, Black Bean Pico, Mozzarella and Cheddar Cheese. Topped with a Creamy Tequila Lime Avocado Sauce. 14.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FISH TACOS
Three lightly seasoned grilled Fish Tacos,Corn Tortilla, spicy Mayo and Slaw. One side. 18.95
 
 
 
 
 
 SHRIMP OR CHICKEN SALAD
Fresh tossed Greens with seasonal Vegetables, Cheddar Cheese, Bacon bits & your choice of dressing. Fried, grilled or blackened. Shrimp 18.95 | Chicken 16.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 House Specialties
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 **CATCH OF THE DAY
Fresh Fish caught straight from theGulf of Mexico. Stuffed, broiled,fried or blackened. MP
 
 
 
 
 
 SEARED TUNA
6oz. Tuna Steak grilled or Blackened topped with Lemon Beurre Blanc Sauce. MP
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 STUFFED CHICKEN BREAST
Local favorite! Chicken filled withdelectable Herbs & Cheese, topped with sauteéd Celery & Mushrooms. 20.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  RIBEYE
Thick and juicy choice hand cut& charbroiled. 14 oz. 44.95
 
 
 
 
 
 FILET MIGNON
Tender choice hand cut, charbroiled to perfection.10 oz. 44.95 | 5 oz. 28.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Enhance Your Entrée By Adding:Signature Cajun BBQ Sauce 4 • Blackened Seasoning 2.5 • Black & Bleu 5Sauteed Mushrooms 4 • Sauteed Onions 3 • Oscar 6
 
 
 
 
 
 STEAK GAUGE:Pittsburgh Rare: charred outside, extra rare inside**Rare: cool, red center**Med Rare: warm, red center**Medium: warm, pink centerMed Well: hot, slightly pink centerWell Done: gray color, somewhat dry
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Seafood-fried|broiled|steamed
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 All éntrees served with your choice of one: Chef Special Side, French Fries, Steamed Broccoli, Baked Sweet Potato, Fried Okra or Baked Potato (Butter, Sour Cream, Chives included, add Cheese and Bacon Bits for 2.75)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FRIED OYSTER DINNER
Select fresh shucked Oysterslightly battered & fried. 26.95
 
 
 
 
 
 STUFFED SHRIMP
Crabmeat Stuffing adds the perfect touch to our popular broiled Gulf Shrimp. 22.95
 
 
 
 
 
 CRAB CAKE DINNER
Crabmeat dressing deep fried, topped with lump Crabmeat & our Remoulade sauce. 18.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 LOBSTER DINNER
Broiled, stuffed, steamed or blackened.When available, we offer 2 (4 oz.)  3 (4 oz.) Tails. MP
 
 
 
 
 
 SNOW CRAB LEGS
With their sweet delicate flavor, these snowy white gems are absolutely luscious.1.5 lb 48.95  1 lb 38.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FRIED SEAFOOD PLATTER
Gulf Shrimp, Oysters, Stuffed Crab& Fresh Catch. 28.95NO SUBSTITUTIONS PLEASE 
 
 
 
 
 
 GULF SHRIMP
Lightly battered & deep fried or broiled. 20.95
 
 
 
 
 
 DELUXE SEAFOOD PLATTER
1 Lobster tail, Snow Crab Legs,Stuffed Shrimp & Steamed Shrimp.Single Double. MP
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Popular Combinations
(subject to availablity)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 5 oz FILET MIGNON
Tender choice & hand cut. 38.95
 
 
 
 
 
 14 oz RIBEYE
Thick & juicy choice hand cut& charbroiled. 52.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 STUFFED CHICKEN BREAST
Local favorite! Chicken filled withdelectable Herbs & Cheese, topped with sauteéd Celery & Mushrooms. 28.95
 
 
 
 
 
 10 oz FILET MIGNON
Tender choice & hand cut. 52.95
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Paired with (choose one): FRIED SHRIMP • BROILED SHRIMP • CRAB CAKE • STEAMED SHRIMP • STUFFED SHRIMP
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Desserts

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 COTTON BLUES CHEESECAKE
It will melt in your mouth.Chocolate, Strawberry, Caramel Topping
 
 
 
 
 
 KEY LIME PIE
Our most popular dessert will complete your meal.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 HOT SOUTHERN APPLE PIE
Topped with walnuts, ice cream & caramel.
 
 
 
 
 
 BROWNIE DELIGHT
Warm brownie topped with ice cream, walnuts& chocolate sauce… Simply Delightful!
 
 
 
 
 
 ICE CREAM
Vanilla • Vanilla with chocolate sauce
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Frozen Drinks

 AMARETTO ORANGE BLOSSOMSTRAWBERRY MARGARITASTRAWBERRY COLADAORANGERASPBERRYMANGOHURRICANE
